512-2691-4091.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-2691-4091.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
512-2691-4091.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-2907-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

215-850-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-6791.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2103-4477-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3603-5195-7487.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Zealous Lorecaster
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Zealous Lorecaster
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1978-5709-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.

413-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

3110-3532-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3110-3532-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

483-2438-4681-5170.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

512-4241-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
512-4241-5457.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4241-5457.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

539-5414-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2829-4112-6767.description:
Cast Rescue Skiff by paying {5}{W}.
When Rescue Skiff enter the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sharuum.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Rescue Skiff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2313-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Conclave Mentor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
2313-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

2811-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2811-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2433-3197.description:
Cast Rosie Cotton by paying {2}{W}.
When Rosie Cotton enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
Rosie Cotton's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

541-3634-3879-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Portal of Sanctuary by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
